Flora × Blooming × Harvest matrix

Associations are based on the latest same-hive inspection within 14 days before harvest and the mean HRI during the preceding 7 days. Multiple flora may be recorded per inspection; charts therefore indicate association, not botanical origin or causation.

Analytical indicators support inspection and harvest planning. Final harvesting decisions should be verified through physical hive inspection. Environmental relationships are associations observed in the recorded data and do not establish causation.
